raw_vs_invalid_control.verdict: INVALID CONTROL: keywords:cli has 104,818 packages and only the top 2.4% by score was sampled

npm_one_version.verdict: DEAD. ~21-26% single-version is the npm baseline when frames are coverage-matched.

npm_age_confound.note: age alone did not explain it (MH OR 16.86 age-adjusted vs the invalid control); coverage did

pypi_no_license.frame: both arms are simple random samples of the complete 886,346-project PyPI index; no score ordering
pypi_no_license.verdict: SURVIVES coverage, age-matching, and external validation

methodological_lesson: npm search orders by score and caps pagination near 5,000. Every npm frame built from it is a top-slice. Comparing top-slices of different-sized populations produces spurious differences. All four npm findings in this study failed once controls were coverage-matched.
